items.note: Apartment 4B is in the subject, the body and the signature.
Says the heater 'has been out since October 2.'
Says 'I phoned you on October 3 and haven't heard back.'
Says 'Overnight temperatures are in the 40s °F now.'
Asks 'Could the repair be done within 48 hours?'
Says Section 12 of the lease requires the landlord to provide heat.

Polite but not firm. The lease point is softened by 'I'm hoping we can get this sorted quickly,' and the 48-hour deadline is a mild question rather than a clear request. Nothing presses the urgency of having no heat for several days.
About 100 words including the subject line, well under 150.
